rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that moves easily and quickly.

example.english: That elderly person is still quite agile when walking.
example.traditional: 嗰位老人家行路仲好靈活。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 lou5 jan4 gaa1 haang4 lou6 zung6 hou2 ling4 wut6

rows.note: Pick this when emphasizing physical nimbleness or skill in movement, especially in sports or action contexts.

example.english: He is agile at table tennis, so his opponent has a hard time returning the ball.
example.traditional: 佢打乒乓波身手敏捷，對手好難接得住。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daa2 bing1 bam1 bo1 san1 sau2 man5 zit3 deoi3 sau2 hou2 naan4 zip3 dak1 zyu6
